question: How is the entanglement of worldly existence characterized in this plea?
premises: Worldly existence is described as a thicket of delusion.
It is also described as darkness veiled by ignorance.
These are conditions from which relief is sought.
inference: Worldly existence is portrayed as a delusive thicket and a darkness of ignorance.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of the accusatives depends on a verb likely in a neighboring verse.
plain_english: The thicket of delusive worldly existence, the darkness of the veil of ignorance.
